milestones.name: Defeat Elder Hu
milestones.note: Spirit of Elder Hu fought at his memorial above the gates to the City of Tears; rewards 100 Essence upon defeat

milestones.name: Collect 100 Essence from Elder Hu
milestones.note: Essence absorbed by the Dream Nail after Elder Hu's spirit shatters

milestones.name: Dream Nail Elder Hu's corpse (Husk Dandy)
milestones.note: Large dead Husk Dandy holding the Love Key can be Dream Nailed for unique dialogue

milestones.name: Acquire Love Key
milestones.note: Found on the corpse of a large dead Husk Dandy in Queen's Gardens

zones.name: Fungal Wastes
zones.fingerprintHint: Fungal-themed area; contains Mantis Village, Queen's Station, and Hot Spring access

zones.name: Mantis Village
zones.note: Location where Elder Hu was killed by the Mantis Lords and the Tribe; within or adjacent to Fungal Wastes

zones.name: City of Tears
zones.note: Elder Hu's memorial is located above its gates; site of the Elder Hu boss fight

zones.name: Queen's Gardens
zones.note: Location of the large dead Husk Dandy corpse holding the Love Key

zones.name: Fog Canyon
zones.note: Southern part connects to Queen's Station and provides entrance to Fungal Wastes

zones.name: Queen's Station
zones.note: Connected to the south part of Fog Canyon; entry node into Fungal Wastes

zones.name: Forgotten Crossroads
zones.note: Southwest part near the Hot Spring provides an alternate entrance to Fungal Wastes

abilities.name: Dream Nail
abilities.note: Required to fight Elder Hu's spirit and to interact with the dead Husk Dandy; collects Essence

abilities.name: Mothwing Cloak
abilities.note: Required to progress further into Fungal Wastes from Fog Canyon or from the Forgotten Crossroads entrance

abilities.name: Shade Cloak
abilities.note: Highly recommended (not required) for dodging Elder Hu's Ring Slam attack; enables dash-through attacks

abilities.name: Howling Wraiths
abilities.note: Spell usable against Elder Hu in a Spell build strategy

abilities.name: Abyss Shriek
abilities.note: Upgraded form of Howling Wraiths; usable against Elder Hu in a Spell build strategy

abilities.name: Vengeful Spirit
abilities.note: 3 casts can substitute for Mothwing Cloak to enter Fungal Wastes from Fog Canyon; commonly used by speedrunners

bosses.name: Elder Hu
bosses.note: Ghost/spirit boss fought at his memorial above the City of Tears gates; requires Dream Nail to trigger fight. Attacks: Ring Slam, Ring Curtain, Teleport. Rewards 100 Essence.

bosses.name: Mantis Lords
bosses.note: Killed Elder Hu in lore; not a boss fought in this segment but referenced contextually
